name: research-p5c
description: P5c: several retrieved domain candidates in RD mode competition. The historical path offers only the minimum-RMS fit to modes 2/3; group `candidates8` offers the eight best-RMS fits instead and charges the same search evaluations (top-k retention adds no fits) plus a little per-leaf mode pricing. Modes 0/2/3 only -- with modes 0/2 alone the wider list is provably inert here, since mode 2's rate is a handful of coordinate symbols while RMS dominates. Lambda grid matches the P5a objective audit (200/800/3200). Kodak grayscale, fixed residual step 8. The fourth lambda point (50) lives in research-p5c-lambda50.json and is appended into the same --out-dir; the two configs together give four distinct points per curve per image, so `marsbench experiment-report --store target/p5c/results.jsonl --reference-group candidates1` yields a real per-image BD-rate instead of a three-point diagnostic.
